new: Studio: a circle made for one scene (Add here, Studio: <scene>) no longer comes up empty when several devices arrive at once.
Each device now waits until it has read the scene before it sends anything to the room; one that is slower takes the items from the room.
A plain studio circle on a relay with only one scene opens it the same way.
Tests: smoke.mjs --only <story> now loads that story before its steps.
test: Make a circle for a scene from Add here (Studio: <scene>) and walk into it with two or three headsets at about the same moment: every headset shows all the scene's items.
A page following that circle shows the same items. Move one item: the others see it move.
Walk out and back in, and join late with another device: the items stay.
On a relay with only one scene, a plain studio circle opens it on every device, with its items.
untested: Scene circles with several real headsets at once: the fix was checked here by reading the code and a smoke check only. The end-to-end round runs before main.
Everything from v136 to v178 that the earlier entries list, except Sharp text, which was tried on a Quest and works.
